name: @aikami/local-stack
description: Docker Compose profiles, Ultimate single container, and Native Host Binary launchers for the local AI engine stack.

scripts.lint: bash -n bin/*.sh docker/voice/entrypoint.sh docker/scripts/entrypoint-ultimate.sh && bunx biome check docker/client-server/client_server.ts && docker compose config --quiet && docker compose --profile full config --quiet && docker compose -f docker-compose.lite.yml config --quiet
scripts.fix: bunx biome check --write docker/client-server/client_server.ts && bash -n bin/*.sh docker/voice/entrypoint.sh docker/scripts/entrypoint-ultimate.sh
scripts.build: bun run build:client && docker compose build
scripts.build:client: cd ../../frontend/client && PUBLIC_OLLAMA_BASE_URL=${LLM_ENDPOINT:-http://localhost:8080/v1} PUBLIC_IMAGE_URL=${IMAGE_ENDPOINT:-http://localhost:8188} PUBLIC_VOICE_URL=${VOICE_ENDPOINT:-http://localhost:6006} bun run build:${CLIENT_MODE:-production} && bun run stage:client
scripts.build:client:docker: bun run build:client && docker build -f Dockerfile.client -t aikami-client .
scripts.build:ultimate: bun run build:client && docker build -f Dockerfile.ultimate -t aikami-ultimate .
